items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: It's a bird on Peacorn Western with a five piece band. A fellow by the name of Winner Island had it.

ctx.x: Cure or so. Yeah, because, and then after that, when things got, just before the war I think it was, things got pretty bad around there for music. Yeah, I remember that. Yeah. So. Or he had a chicken farm and all that. And Papa Mutt, I think he went to work on a road, Porter, and I went to work at a place they call it Strip City now. It's a bird on Peacorn Western with a five piece band. A fellow by the name of Winner Island had it. And then that's where I got drafted again.
Yeah, drafted in two R's. In two R's.
